title: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid
caption: The Great Pyramid was about 2,500 years old when Cleopatra was born. Apollo 11 came 2,000 years after her.
description: The Great Pyramid of Giza was built for Khufu, whose reign ended around 2600 BC. Cleopatra VII was born in 69 BC, about 2,500 years later. From her birth to the Apollo 11 landing in 1969 is 2,037 years. Published dates for Khufu differ by more than a century; even the latest still puts the pyramid some 2,400 years before Cleopatra.
sources: Erdil et al. 2025, PLOS ONE, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0314612
